title: Most World Cup goals scored
brief: Name the ten nations that have scored the most goals at World Cup finals tournaments.
period: Every World Cup, 1930 to 2026. Shoot-out goals don't count.

notes.Russia: Russia (with the Soviet Union) have 77, just outside.
notes.Germany: Germany's figures include West Germany (1950 to 1990) and the pre-war Germany team, as FIFA counts them; the slot takes Germany or West Germany.

checks: The current all-time table was rebuilt as the 29 May 2026 version of the same table plus every team's 2026 record from the 2026 tournament ranking (sourced to FIFA's competition summary): all 81 main rows agree. Germany's row also equals the sum of its Germany 1934-38, West Germany and Germany since 1994 sub-rows. Sweden (80 before 2026, 7 in 2026) and Hungary (87, not at a World Cup since 1986) are level on 87 for 10th, so they share the last slot.
